_authority: Authored from the executed remediation record of gates 4N-I27L, I27M, I27O and I27R. It is NOT generated from the tests directory; a guard in tests/test_i27r_rejection_remediation.py asserts that independence structurally.
_purpose: The INDEPENDENT registry of remediation regression pins (Gate 4N-I27R).
_why_this_file_exists: Gate 4N-I27Q's architect lane showed that tests/fixtures/package-requirements.json did not
checked only required-subset-of-present. Deleting that single file from the index and the
ci_invocation_model, allow_model and protected_inventory ALL green while the sole
regression pin for four High remediations vanished. A one-directional check over a list
that nobody updates when the package grows cannot notice its own incompleteness.
This registry names, per remediation family, the source that was fixed, the test that pins
it, the canary that reproduces the original defect, and the control that must refuse. It is
compared with the tree in BOTH directions, and every named path must exist.
